title: Home Assistant event <ns>_tag_scanned (data)
description: Fired by the integration when the hub reports a resolved tag (ws/integration/ha_event with kind tag_scanned), in addition to <ns>_event, so owners can trigger their own automations by tag (like HA's tag_scanned). Fired for every result, so automations filter on result ok. The app never calls fire_event itself. Only admins can subscribe to it over the WebSocket API.
